title: Order of a quasi-coherent ideal at a scheme point
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $I$ a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf, represented by its compatible affine ideals [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Its stalk ideal $I_x\subset\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is the ideal generated by all germs of its sections on affine neighbourhoods of $x$. Define $\operatorname{ord}_x I=\sup\{q\in\mathbf N:I_x\subset\mathfrak m_x^q\}\in\mathbf N\cup\{\infty\}$, using ideal powers [def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers]. In particular the zero stalk ideal has infinite order. This is data and a definition, not a finiteness assertion.

source.place: ILO VIII 2.3.11--2.3.13, pp.93--94 (referral to BMT); detailed source: BMT arXiv:0905.3580, section 5.1
